name: Cross-asset contagion — BTC crowd spike, trend-gated alt swing (1d)
rationale: MECHANISM: the same BTC-attention-leads-alts contagion, expressed as a low-turnover 1d swing. A btc_social_accel spike broadcasts risk-on rotation; we take the alt long only when the alt is in a real trend (adx above a fitted floor) so the rotating flow has a directional channel to push, not chop. The daily cadence matches the ~1d lead documented internally and keeps costs low. Counterparty is day-late alt repricers. DISCONFIRMER: regress out contemporaneous BTC return — the increment over lagged BTC-beta must survive. Ablate the adx gate: if the trend filter alone (no BTC-attention trigger) reproduces the return, the contagion adds nothing, KILL. Shuffle BTC's attention series; the effect must vanish.
catalyst: BTC attention spike into a trending alt — slow risk-on rotation
